This application concerns {name}, a commercial greenhouse operation in {town}. The growing space covers {sqft} square feet under a covering of {covering}, and the site is served by {utility}. Our area sees about {hdd} heating degree days a year, so the greenhouse must be heated for much of the growing season. We estimate our annual heating cost at {estimate_point} dollars, within a range of {estimate_low} to {estimate_high} dollars.

The operation is actively engaged in commercial agricultural production. We grow {UNKNOWN: crops grown and annual production volume} and sell to {UNKNOWN: markets served}. Greenhouse production accounts for {UNKNOWN: share of farm income from greenhouse production} of the business and is central to how the farm earns its income. The farm has been in continuous operation for {UNKNOWN: years in continuous operation}.

This project fits our business goals because heating fuel is one of our largest operating costs. Long, cold winters in our region make heat loss through the greenhouse covering a direct operational challenge, and reducing that loss is the most practical way to protect our margins and keep growing through the cold months.

Previous grant funding: {UNKNOWN: previous grant awards received and how they were used}. We will manage project funds through the farm's existing bookkeeping, keeping every invoice and payment record for the project.
